papers.title: Prognostic significance of tumoral Siglec-15 expression in solid tumors: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Zhang N, He Y, Qin Z, Yu J, Guo W
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Siglec-15 has emerged as a novel immune checkpoint molecule and a potential therapeutic target in solid tumors. Previous studies reported inconsistent prognostic significance of tumoral Siglec-15 expression across cancer types. We therefore conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to comprehensively evaluate the association of tumoral Siglec-15 expression with survival outcomes in patients with solid tumors.
METHODS: PubMed, Web of Science, and EMBASE were systematically searched from database inception to March 30, 2026. Observational studies investigating Siglec-15 protein expression in tumor cells and prognosis were included. Study quality was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Random-effects models were applied to calculate pooled hazard ratios (HRs) and odds ratios (ORs) with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Prespecified subgroup analyses, meta-regression analyses, and publication bias assessment were performed.
RESULTS: Twenty-seven datasets involving 4075 patients were included. High tumoral Siglec-15 expression was significantly associated with poorer overall survival (OS, HR = 1.53, 95% CI: 1.25-1.86, P < 0.001) and worse disease-free/recurrence-free survival (DFS/RFS, HR = 1.30, 95% CI: 1.09-1.55, P = 0.004). No significant association was observed for progression-free survival (HR = 1.03, 95% CI: 0.67-1.56, P = 0.903). High Siglec-15 expression showed a marginal association with improved disease-specific survival (DSS, HR = 0.66, 95% CI: 0.43-1.00, P = 0.050). Tumor-specific analyses demonstrated significantly worse OS in colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and osteosarcoma, whereas breast cancer showed a non-significant association in the opposite direction (HR = 0.72, 95% CI: 0.33-1.56). Tumoral Siglec-15 expression was inversely associated with PD-L1 positivity (OR = 0.40, 95% CI: 0.23-0.72, P = 0.002), supporting a mutually exclusive immune checkpoint pattern. No significant associations were observed between Siglec-15 expression and most clinicopathological features.
CONCLUSIONS: Elevated tumoral Siglec-15 expression was associated with unfavorable OS and DFS/RFS, whereas the borderline association with improved DSS should be interpreted cautiously because it was based on only three studies. These findings support a highly cancer-type dependent role of Siglec-15 as a clinically relevant prognostic biomarker and a promising immunotherapeutic target. Further prospective studies are needed to validate these findings and develop standardized assessment strategies, preferably using fixed cutoff values and simplified scoring methods.

papers.title_zh: 腫瘤性Siglec-15表現在實體腫瘤中的預後意義：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：Siglec-15已成為一種新型免疫檢查點分子，並可能為實體腫瘤的治療靶點。先前研究對於腫瘤性Siglec-15表現在不同癌症類型中的預後意義報告不一致。因此我們進行系統性回顧與統合分析，全面評估實體腫瘤病人中腫瘤性Siglec-15表現與存活結果的關聯。

方法：系統性檢索PubMed、Web of Science及EMBASE資料庫，從建庫起至2026年3月30日。納入探討腫瘤細胞Siglec-15蛋白表現與預後關係的觀察性研究。使用Newcastle-Ottawa量表評估研究品質。採用隨機效應模型計算合併風險比（HR）與勝算比（OR）及其95%信賴區間（CI）。進行預先設定之次群組分析、meta回歸分析及發表偏誤評估。

結果：共納入27個資料集、4075名病人。高腫瘤性Siglec-15表現與較差整體存活（OS，HR=1.53，95% CI：1.25-1.86，P<0.001）及較差無病/無復發存活（DFS/RFS，HR=1.30，95% CI：1.09-1.55，P=0.004）顯著相關。無疾病惡化存活（PFS）未觀察到顯著關聯（HR=1.03，95% CI：0.67-1.56，P=0.903）。高Siglec-15表現與較佳疾病特異性存活（DSS）呈邊緣性關聯（HR=0.66，95% CI：0.43-1.00，P=0.050）。腫瘤特異性分析顯示大腸直腸癌、胃癌及骨肉瘤病人OS顯著較差，而乳癌則呈現方向相反但未達統計顯著的關聯（HR=0.72，95% CI：0.33-1.56）。腫瘤性Siglec-15表現與PD-L1陽性呈負相關（OR=0.40，95% CI：0.23-0.72，P=0.002），支持互斥的免疫檢查點型態。Siglec-15表現與大多數臨床病理特徵之間未觀察到顯著關聯。

結論：腫瘤性Siglec-15表現升高與較差的OS及DFS/RFS相關，而其與較佳DSS之邊緣性關聯應謹慎解讀，因僅基於三篇研究。這些發現支持Siglec-15作為具高度癌症類型依賴性、具臨床相關性之預後生物標記及具前景之免疫治療靶點的角色。未來需要更多前瞻性研究以驗證這些發現，並發展標準化評估策略，最好使用固定切點值與簡化評分方法。
papers.score_reason: 為異質性觀察性研究之統合分析，IHC切點未標準化，且Siglec-15目前無臨床可用檢測或治療，對外科實務暫無直接可行動性。
papers.relevance_why: 純生物標記預後研究，非手術介入，Siglec-15尚無臨床可用檢測或已核准治療。

papers.title: Influence of KRAS mutation subtypes on response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: meta-analysis
papers.authors: Sadien I, Cooper G, Phillips V, Joshi H, Wheeler J, Davies R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: KRAS mutations are common in colorectal cancer, but the impact of KRAS mutation subtypes on treatment response remains poorly understood. This research aimed to investigate whether different KRAS mutations influence pathological complete response (pCR) rates after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC).
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies describing genetic determinants of response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in LARC was conducted, searching for manuscripts published up to March 2026. The primary outcome of interest was the odds ratio for KRAS mutations and pCR. A random-effects model estimated the pooled effect size of KRAS mutations within and outside exon 2 on pCR. Genomic data sets were analysed to investigate the molecular characteristics of KRAS exon 2 and non-exon 2 mutant rectal cancers and their impact on overall and disease-free survival. Finally, a transcriptomic data set was analysed to elucidate the underlying response mechanisms.
RESULTS: Out of 11 537 manuscripts identified, 15 studies (3354 patients) were included in the meta-analysis. The odds ratio for any KRAS mutation and pCR was 0.48 (95% confidence interval 0.32 to 0.70), indicating reduced odds of pCR in KRAS-mutant LARC. Subgroup analysis revealed that KRAS mutations in exon 2 accounted for this effect, whereas variants outside exon 2 had no influence (odds ratio 0.96, 95% confidence interval 0.11 to 8.49). Analysis confirmed poorer disease-free survival in patients with exon 2 alterations (P = 0.019) as well as poorer overall survival (P = 0.047). Transcriptomic analysis revealed that non-exon 2 KRAS-mutant tumours were enriched for inflammatory signalling pathways, suggesting that these tumours represent a subgroup with high immune infiltration.
CONCLUSION: The presence of KRAS mutations adversely affects pCR odds after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in LARC, but this effect is specific to exon 2 mutations.

papers.title_zh: KRAS突變亞型對局部進展期直腸癌新輔助放化療反應之影響：統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：KRAS突變在大腸直腸癌中常見，但KRAS突變亞型對治療反應的影響仍未被充分了解。本研究旨在探討不同KRAS突變是否會影響局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）接受新輔助放化療後之病理完全緩解（pCR）率。

方法：本研究進行系統性回顧與統合分析，納入描述LARC新輔助放化療反應之遺傳決定因子的研究，檢索至2026年3月為止發表之文獻。主要感興趣結果為KRAS突變與pCR之勝算比（OR）。以隨機效應模型估算exon 2內與exon 2外之KRAS突變對pCR的合併效應量。並分析基因體資料集以探討KRAS exon 2與非exon 2突變直腸癌之分子特徵及其對整體存活與無病存活之影響。最後，分析轉錄體資料集以闡明潛在反應機制。

結果：從11,537篇文獻中，共納入15篇研究（3,354名病人）進行統合分析。任何KRAS突變與pCR的勝算比為0.48（95%信賴區間0.32至0.70），顯示KRAS突變型LARC達到pCR的機率降低。次群組分析顯示此效應主要來自exon 2的KRAS突變，而exon 2以外的變異則無影響（勝算比0.96，95%信賴區間0.11至8.49）。分析證實exon 2突變患者之無病存活較差（P=0.019），整體存活也較差（P=0.047）。轉錄體分析顯示非exon 2 KRAS突變腫瘤富含發炎訊號路徑，提示這些腫瘤代表具高免疫浸潤特徵之亞群。

結論：KRAS突變會不利影響LARC新輔助放化療後之pCR勝算，但此效應僅侵限於exon 2突變。
papers.score_reason: 樣本量大（3354人）且有分子機轉支持，但納入研究異質性高、非exon2組信賴區間極寬，目前僅屬探索性、尚無法直接改變臨床決策。

papers.title: Quality of life, bowel dysfunction, and long-term oncological outcomes after transanal versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision for mid- and low- rectal cancer (Ta-LaTME study): multicentre randomized open-label trial
papers.authors: Serra-Aracil X, Gonzalez A, Bargalló J, Serracant A, Roura J, Cayetano-Paniagua L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Quality of life (QoL) and bowel function are key outcomes in mid- and low rectal cancer. The comparative impact of laparoscopic total mesorectal excision (LaTME) versus transanal total mesorectal excision (TaTME) on patient-reported outcomes and long-term oncological results in randomized trials remains unclear.
METHODS: This prospective multicentre randomized trial enrolled patients with resectable mid-low rectal adenocarcinoma. QoL was assessed using the 30- and 29-item European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Core Questionnaires EORTC QLQ-C30 and QLQ-CR29, respectively) and bowel dysfunction was assessed using the Low Anterior Resection Syndrome (LARS) score before surgery and at the long-term follow-up (≥ 12 months after index surgery). The sample size calculation was based on the primary endpoint from the original randomized clinical trial (composite conversion outcome), for which 116 patients were required. The minimum oncological follow-up was 5 years. Modified intention-to-treat (mITT) and per-protocol analyses were prespecified.
RESULTS: In all, 116 patients were randomized (LaTME, 57; TaTME, 59); 105 patients were included in the mITT analysis. Sixty-seven valid QoL questionnaires were obtained (63.8%). Postoperative global health status (EORTC QLQ-C30) was high in both groups (median score 83.3) with no significant differences between them, and functional scales remained near maximum, with improved emotional functioning after LaTME only. Using the EORTC QLQ-CR29 score, TaTME showed higher postoperative stool frequency, flatulence, and faecal incontinence, with similar body image and sexual function. LARS scores (assessed only in patients without a permanent stoma) were comparable between LaTME and TaTME (median 24 versus 27, respectively), with major LARS (score 30-42) in 30 and 44% of LaTME and TaTME patients respectively. There were no significant differences between LaTME and TaTME in local recurrence (6.4% versus 3.7%, respectively), distant recurrence (14.9% versus 18.5%, respectively), disease-free survival, and overall survival.
CONCLUSION: Overall QoL and bowel function remained high, with no detectable between-group differences. TaTME was associated with a higher burden of specific evacuatory symptoms on the EORTC QLQ-CR29. Long-term oncological outcomes did not differ significantly between techniques. Registration number: NCT02550769 (http://www.clinicaltrials.gov).

papers.title_zh: 中低位直腸癌經肛門全直腸系膜切除術（TaTME）與腹腔鏡全直腸系膜切除術（LaTME）之生活品質、排便功能與長期腫瘤學結果比較（Ta-LaTME研究）：多中心隨機開放標籤試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：生活品質（QoL）與排便功能是中低位直腸癌的關鍵結果指標。在隨機試驗中，腹腔鏡全直腸系膜切除術（LaTME）與經肛門全直腸系膜切除術（TaTME）對病人自述結果與長期腫瘤學結果的相對影響仍不明確。方法：此前瞻性多中心隨機試驗納入可切除中低位直腸腺癌病人。術前及長期追蹤（術後≥12個月）時，以歐洲癌症研究與治療組織生活品質核心問卷（EORTC QLQ-C30及QLQ-CR29，各30項及29項）評估QoL，並以低前位切除症候群（LARS）評分評估排便功能。樣本量計算依據原始隨機臨床試驗之主要終點（複合式轉開刀結果），需116名病人。最低腫瘤學追蹤時間為5年。預先設定修正型意向治療（mITT）分析及依計畫分析。結果：共116名病人隨機分派（LaTME組57人，TaTME組59人）；105名病人納入mITT分析。共取得67份有效QoL問卷（63.8%）。兩組術後整體健康狀態（EORTC QLQ-C30）皆偏高（中位數83.3分），組間無顯著差異，功能量表亦接近滿分，僅LaTME組情緒功能有改善。以EORTC QLQ-CR29評估，TaTME組術後排便頻率、排氣及大便失禁較高，但身體形象與性功能相似。LARS評分（僅於無永久性造口病人中評估）在LaTME與TaTME組間相當（中位數分別為24與27），重度LARS（評分30-42）發生率分別為LaTME組30%與TaTME組44%。LaTME與TaTME組間局部復發（分別為6.4%與3.7%）、遠端復發（分別為14.9%與18.5%）、無疾病存活與整體存活均無顯著差異。結論：整體QoL與排便功能仍維持良好，組間無可偵測差異。TaTME在EORTC QLQ-CR29上與較高的特定排便症狀負擔相關。兩種術式長期腫瘤學結果無顯著差異。註冊號：NCT02550769。
papers.score_reason: 5年腫瘤學追蹤的多中心RCT具參考價值，但此QoL/腫瘤學分析非原試驗主要終點（樣本量未針對此設計），QoL問卷回收率僅63.8%，可信度受限。
papers.relevance_why: TaTME與LaTME的選擇及其對排便功能與長期腫瘤學結果的影響，是台灣直腸癌手術決策的核心議題。
papers.one_liner: 在116名中低位直腸癌病人中，比較TaTME與LaTME，發現5年腫瘤學結果相近，但TaTME排便症狀負擔較高（重度LARS 44% vs 30%）。
papers.action: 選擇術式時仍以腫瘤學安全性為主要考量；若病人特別重視術後排便功能，可優先考慮LaTME或加強TaTME術後排便功能追蹤與衛教。

pico.I: 經肛門全直腸系膜切除術（TaTME）
pico.C: 腹腔鏡全直腸系膜切除術（LaTME）
pico.O: 主要：生活品質（EORTC QLQ-C30/CR29）、LARS評分；次要：局部/遠端復發、無疾病存活、整體存活

papers.title: Tumor stroma-immune interactions shape the immunosuppressive microenvironment and predict response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus immunotherapy in rectal cancer
papers.authors: Wang Q, Tian N, Guo H, Xiang Y, Xiao Y, Lin G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The tumor microenvironment, particularly the tumor stroma, plays a critical role in tumor progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic resistance. However, its interaction with the immune landscape in rectal cancer (RC) remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to comprehensively characterize the stromal-immune ecosystem associated with the tumor stroma ratio (TSR) in RC and to evaluate its clinical and therapeutic relevance.
METHODS: We analyzed a multicenter cohort of 498 patients with treatment-naïve RC in whom TSR was assessed on H&E-stained sections. Integrative multi-omics analyses were performed, including bulk RNA sequencing (n=118) and single-cell RNA/T-cell receptor (TCR) sequencing (n=10). Key findings were validated by immunohistochemistry (n=114) and multiplex immunofluorescence (n=20). Survival analyses and statistical comparisons were conducted to evaluate clinical associations and treatment responses.
RESULTS: High TSR was an independent predictor of unfavorable disease-free survival and cancer-specific survival and was associated with aggressive clinicopathological features. Single-cell analyses revealed that TSR-high tumors exhibited a profoundly immunosuppressive microenvironment, characterized by clonally expanded terminally exhausted CD8+ T cells (CD8+ Tex-CXCL13) and activated CD4+ regulatory T cells (CD4+ Treg-TNFRSF4). Two LRRC15+ cancer-associated fibroblast (CAF) subsets (mCAF-CTHRC1 and mCAF-FAP) were enriched in TSR-high tumors. Among them, mCAF-CTHRC1 was associated with increased Treg abundance and activation features, with predicted interactions with CD4+ Treg-TNFRSF4 cells through the LGALS9-CD44 signaling axis. In addition, SPP1-expressing monocytes (Mon-SPP1) and malignant epithelial cells were prominent in TSR-high tumors and showed a predicted SPP1-CD44 interaction with T-cell subsets, suggesting potential involvement in immunosuppressive stromal-immune interactions. In patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy, pretreatment TSR-low tumors showed improved pathological response and survival outcomes compared with TSR-high tumors. In the neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus immunotherapy cohort, TSR-low tumors were associated with a significantly higher major pathological response rate, whereas pathological complete response showed a non-significant trend in the same direction.
CONCLUSIONS: High TSR identifies a clinically aggressive subtype of RC characterized by a profoundly immunosuppressive stromal-immune ecosystem enriched for exhausted T cells, immunosuppressive CAF programs, and SPP1-associated stromal-myeloid interactions. These findings highlight LGALS9-, LRRC15-, and SPP1-related stromal-immune pathways as candidate stromal-immune therapeutic vulnerabilities that warrant further mechanistic and preclinical validation.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌中腫瘤間質-免疫交互作用形塑免疫抑制微環境並預測新輔助放化療合併免疫治療之反應
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：腫瘤微環境，特別是腫瘤間質，在腫瘤進展、免疫逃逸及治療抗性中扮演關鍵角色。然而其與直腸癌（RC）免疫景觀的交互作用仍未完全明瞭。本研究旨在全面描繪與腫瘤間質比（TSR）相關之間質-免疫生態系統，並評估其臨床及治療相關性。
方法：我們分析了一個多中心隊列，共498名未經治療的RC病人，於H&E染色切片上評估TSR。進行了整合性多體學分析，包括整體RNA測序（n=118）及單細胞RNA/T細胞受體（TCR）測序（n=10）。關鍵發現以免疫組織化學（n=114）及多重免疫螢光（n=20）進行驗證。並進行存活分析及統計比較以評估臨床關聯性及治療反應。
結果：高TSR是無病存活期及癌症特異性存活期不良的獨立預測因子，且與侵襲性臨床病理特徵相關。單細胞分析顯示TSR高的腫瘤呈現深度免疫抑制微環境，特徵為克隆性擴增的終末耗竭CD8+T細胞（CD8+ Tex-CXCL13）及活化的CD4+調節性T細胞（CD4+ Treg-TNFRSF4）。兩個LRRC15+癌症相關纤維母細胞（CAF）亞群（mCAF-CTHRC1及mCAF-FAP）在TSR高腫瘤中富集。其中，mCAF-CTHRC1與Treg數量增加及活化特徵相關，並預測透過LGALS9-CD44訊號軸與CD4+ Treg-TNFRSF4細胞交互作用。此外，表達SPP1的單核細胞（Mon-SPP1）及惡性上皮細胞在TSR高腫瘤中顯著存在，並顯示與T細胞亞群間預測的SPP1-CD44交互作用，提示其可能參與免疫抑制性間質-免疫交互作用。在接受新輔助治療的病人中，治療前TSR低的腫瘤相較於TSR高的腫瘤顯示更佳的病理反應及存活結果。在新輔助放化療合併免疫治療隊列中，TSR低腫瘤與顯著較高的主要病理反應率相關，而病理完全反應則呈現同方向但無統計顯著之趨勢。
結論：高TSR標誌一種臨床侵襲性的RC亞型，其特徵為深度免疫抑制的間質-免疫生態系統，富含耗竭T細胞、免疫抑制性CAF程式及SPP1相關間質-骨髓交互作用。這些發現凸顯LGALS9、LRRC15及SPP1相關間質-免疫路徑為候選的間質-免疫治療脆弱點，值得進一步機制性及臨床前驗證。

papers.title: A mitochondrial antioxidant axis fuels iron addiction in colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) cells accumulate iron to fuel proliferation yet paradoxically resist its toxicity. Jain et al. reveal that heme stabilizes succinate dehydrogenase subunit C, sustaining complex II-dependent coenzyme Q reduction and its redistribution to the plasma membrane, enabling CRC cells to buffer oxidative stress and iron-induced cell death.

papers.title: Real-World Evidence for Oncology Patients With Rare NTRK Gene Fusions: Final Results From the German Multicenter Patient Cohort Study REALTRK
papers.authors: Potthoff K, Lange S, Seufferlein T, Heinrich K, Claus R, Bleckmann A
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: TRK inhibitors (TRKis) have transformed the therapeutic landscape for patients with neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion-positive tumors. However, approval of TRKis is based on evidence derived mainly from small, pooled, single-arm clinical trial cohorts. The REALTRK registry aims to describe real-world molecular diagnostic practices, treatment patterns, and clinical outcomes for adult patients with NTRK fusion-positive cancers.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: The REALTRK registry was a multicenter cohort study that included adults with advanced solid tumors harboring NTRK1/2/3 fusions, from Germany and Switzerland. Both retrospective and prospective data were collected from diverse clinical settings. NTRK fusions had to be diagnosed via validated assays.
RESULTS: Of 88 patients screened, 47 adults with advanced NTRK fusion-positive solid tumors were included in the full analysis set. Across all treatment lines after NTRK fusion diagnosis, 29 patients received TRKi therapy, eight received non-TRKi therapy, and 10 received no therapy. Lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and soft tissue sarcoma were the most common tumor types. Next-generation sequencing was the primary diagnostic method, with a median turnaround time of 2 weeks. After NTRK fusion diagnosis, TRKi therapy was immediately initiated in 26 patients, of whom 13 received TRKi as first-line treatment in the advanced/metastatic setting. About half of the patients responded to TRKi treatment as the first treatment line after NTRK fusion diagnosis (46.2%), with an overall response rate of 46.2% and a disease control rate of 73.1%. The median progression-free survival was 15.7 months, and the overall survival was 27.6 months in TRKi-treated patients.
CONCLUSION: The REALTRK registry provides important real-world insights into the patient path of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors harboring NTRK1/2/3 gene fusions.
papers.title_zh: 罕見NTRK基因融合腫瘤成人患者的真實世界證據：德國多中心患者登記研究REALTRK最終結果
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：TRK抑制劑（TRKi）已改變NTRK（神經營養性酪胺酸受體激酶）基因融合陽性腫瘤患者的治療版圖。然而TRKi的核准主要基於小型、匯集、單臂臨床試驗族群的證據。REALTRK登記研究旨在描述NTRK融合陽性癌症成人患者的真實世界分子診斷模式、治療型態與臨床結果。患者與方法：REALTRK登記研究為一項多中心世代研究，納入德國與瑞士帶有NTRK1/2/3融合的晚期實性腫瘤成人患者，同時收集回溯性與前瞻性資料，來自多元臨床場域。NTRK融合須經驗證過的檢測方法診斷。結果：篩檢88名患者後，47名晚期NTRK融合陽性實性腫瘤成人納入完整分析集。在NTRK融合診斷後所有治療線中，29名患者接受TRKi治療、8名接受非TRKi治療、10名未接受治療。肺癌、大腸癌與軟組織肉瘤為最常見腫瘤類型。次世代測序（NGS）為主要診斷方法，中位周轉時間為2週。NTRK融合診斷後，26名患者立即開始TRKi治療，其中13名在晚期／轉移性情境下接受TRKi作為第一線治療。約半數患者對NTRK融合診斷後第一線治療產生反應（46.2%），整體反應率為46.2%，疾病控制率為73.1%。TRKi治療患者的中位無惡化存活期為15.7個月，整體存活期為27.6個月。結論：REALTRK登記研究提供了帶有NTRK1/2/3基因融合之局部晚期或轉移性實性腫瘤成人患者就醫路徑的重要真實世界洞見。
papers.score_reason: 單臂真實世界登記研究，樣本量小、無正式對照組，且大腸癌僅為混合腫瘤族群之一，對大腸直腸外科臨床決策的直接實用性有限。
papers.relevance_why: NTRK融合陽性在大腸直腸癌中極為罕見（<1%），此研究為藥物治療（非手術介入）且未單獨呈現大腸癌亞群數據。
papers.one_liner: 在47名NTRK融合陽性晚期實性腫瘤患者（含大腸癌）中，真實世界TRKi治療反應率46.2%、中位PFS 15.7個月、OS 27.6個月。
papers.action: 目前不需改變外科做法；若MDT遇罕見NTRK融合陽性轉移性大腸癌，建議轉介腫瘤內科評估TRKi治療選項。

pico.C: 非TRKi治療（8人）或未接受任何治療（10人）－非隨機分組，非嚴謹對照
pico.O: 主要：整體反應率(ORR)、疾病控制率(DCR)、無惡化存活期(PFS)、整體存活期(OS)；次要：診斷方式、治療型態、NGS周轉時間

TRKi治療患者中位PFS 15.7個月，中位OS 27.6個月
88人篩檢僅47人確診NTRK融合並納入分析，29人實際接受TRKi治療

papers.title: Circular stapler platform and the risk of anastomotic leakage after elective left colectomy and high anterior resection
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Guadagni S, Catarci M, Masedu F, Italian ColoRectal Anastomotic Leakage (iCral) study group
papers.abstract:
AIM: The impact of different circular stapler platforms on the risk of anastomotic leakage following elective left colectomy and high anterior resection remains poorly defined. We compared the risk of anastomotic leakage across commonly used circular stapler platforms using advanced confounding control methods.
METHODS: This pre-planned post hoc analysis pooled individual patient data from the published iCral-2 and iCral-3 studies and from the iCral-4 study, whose primary results are currently under peer review. Adults undergoing elective left colectomy or high anterior resection with standardized end-to-end circular stapled anastomosis were included. Five circular stapler platforms were compared. Confounding was addressed using generalized boosted model-based propensity score weighting targeting the average treatment effect on the treated, with doubly robust outcome modelling. The primary endpoint was overall anastomotic leakage at 60 days.
RESULTS: Among 3,653 patients, overall anastomotic leakage occurred in 2.7% of patients receiving the reference 3-row platform. After weighting, Platforms 3 and 4 were associated with a significantly increased risk of overall anastomotic leakage (odds ratios >2), whereas no statistically significant differences were observed for Platforms 2 or 5. Because the effective sample size after weighting was substantially reduced for Platform 3 owing to limited covariate overlap, the corresponding effect estimate should be interpreted with appropriate caution.
CONCLUSIONS: Selected circular stapler platforms were associated with an increased risk of overall anastomotic leakage. These findings suggest platform-specific rather than class-wide differences and warrant confirmation in prospective studies designed to identify the device-related and procedural factors underlying these associations.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: NCT03771456 for iCral2, NCT04397627 for iCral3 and NCT05227014 for iCral4.
papers.title_zh: 選擇性左側結腸切除術與高位前切除術中，圓形吻合器平台與吻合口滲漏風險之關聯
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：不同圓形吻合器平台對於選擇性左側結腸切除術及高位前切除術後吻合口滲漏風險之影響，目前仍未被清楚定義。本研究使用進階干擾因子控制方法，比較常用圓形吻合器平台間的吻合口滲漏風險。方法：本研究為事先規劃的事後分析，合併了已發表之iCral-2、iCral-3研究，以及目前正在同儕審查中的iCral-4研究之個別病人資料。納入接受標準端對端圓形吻合器吻合之選擇性左側結腸切除術或高位前切除術之成年病人。比較五種圓形吻合器平台。干擾因子控制採用以廣義提升模型（generalized boosted model）為基礎之傾向分數加權，目標為treated族群之平均處理效應（ATT），並搭配雙重穩健結果模型。主要終點為60天內整體吻合口滲漏。結果：在3,653名病人中，接受參考用三排釘（3-row）平台者，整體吻合口滲漏發生率為2.7%。經加權後，平台3與平台4與顯著升高之整體吻合口滲漏風險相關（勝算比>2），而平台2與平台5則未觀察到統計上顯著差異。由於平台3在加權後，因共變量重疊有限，其有效樣本數大幅減少，其相應效應估計值應謹慎解讀。結論：特定圓形吻合器平台與吻合口滲漏風險升高相關。此發現顯示差異為特定平台所致，而非整體類別性差異，仍需前瞻性研究設計以確認並釐清其背後與裝置及手術操作相關之因素。試驗註冊：iCral2為NCT03771456，iCral3為NCT04397627，iCral4為NCT05227014。
papers.score_reason: 大樣本、跨三個前瞻性世代之IPD合併分析並用傾向分數加權控制干擾，但本質仍為非隨機事後分析，且摘要未揭露平台廠牌名稱，臨床可用性受限。

papers.title: Colorectal Cancer Mortality Following an Organized Fecal Immunochemical Test-Based Screening Program
papers.authors: Bujanda L, Val B, Portillo Villares I, Idigoras-Rubio I, Banales J, Gutierrez-Stampa M
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Organized screening programs using the fecal immunochemical test (FIT) have been implemented to reduce CRC mortality through early detection.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the association between an organized FIT-based screening program and CRC-specific mortality in a population-based setting.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This retrospective, population-based cohort study included all residents of the Basque Country, Spain (approximately 2.2 million inhabitants) between 2004 and 2024. The FIT-based CRC screening program targeting individuals aged 50 to 69 years was initiated in 2009. Individuals aged less than 50 years were included in the study as a nonscreening reference group. Data analysis was performed in April 2026.
EXPOSURE: Biennial screening of asymptomatic individuals aged 50 to 69 years using single-sample FIT.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Age-standardized mortality rates (ASMRs) for CRC per 100 000 population (based on the European Standard Population 2013) and annual mortality trends from 2004 through 2024 were calculated. Segmented regression and counterfactual analyses estimated changes in CRC mortality after screening implementation. Screening participation, FIT positivity, colonoscopy adherence, CRC detection rates, and cancer stage distribution were also evaluated.
RESULTS: Among 438 134 total deaths (50.9% in men) in a population of approximately 2.2. million, 16 298 (3.7%) were attributable to CRC. Age-standardized CRC mortality declined from 32.8 to 23.1 deaths per 100 000 population between 2004 and 2024 (reduction of 29.6%; P = .002). In individuals aged 50 to 69 years, CRC mortality declined by 50.1% (from 39.7 to 19.8 deaths per 100 000 population). Segmented regression identified a significant inflection point in the year 2012 (95% CI, 2011-2014; P < .001), 3 years after screening implementation. Counterfactual analyses estimated a 46.2% relative reduction in CRC mortality in the group aged 50 to 69 years compared with projected trends without screening. Among individuals aged 70 years or older, CRC mortality declined by 19.6% (from 165.4 to 132.9 deaths per 100 000 population), corresponding to a 45.4% relative reduction compared with projected rates. Overall, 3464 of 4892 screen-detected CRCs (70.8%) were diagnosed at stage I or II throughout the study period.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this retrospective, population-based, descriptive cohort study, organized FIT-based screening was associated with a sustained decline in CRC mortality, particularly among individuals aged 50 to 69 years. These findings support the long-term benefit of organized FIT-based screening programs as a public health strategy to reduce CRC-related mortality.

papers.title_zh: 組織化糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）篩檢計畫實施後之大腸直腸癌死亡率
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球癌症相關死亡的主要原因之一。採用糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）的組織化篩檢計畫已被推行，以透過早期偵測降低CRC死亡率。
目的：評估組織化FIT篩檢計畫與人群層級CRC特異性死亡率之關聯。
設計、場域與參與者：本回溯性、以人群為基礎的世代研究納入西班牙巴斯克地區（約220萬居民）2004年至2024年間的所有居民。針對50至69歲個體的FIT篩檢計畫於2009年開始實施。50歲以下個體被納入研究作為未篩檢的參考組。資料分析於2026年4月進行。
暴露：對50至69歲無症狀個體進行雙年一次、單次採樣FIT篩檢。
主要結果與測量：計算CRC年齡標準化死亡率（ASMR，每10萬人口，以2013年歐洲標準人口為基準）以及2004至2024年間之年度死亡率趨勢。以分段迴歸與反事實分析估計篩檢實施後CRC死亡率的變化。同時評估篩檢參與率、FIT陽性率、大腸鏡順從率、CRC偵測率及癌症期別分布。
結果：在總人口約220萬中，共發生438,134例死亡（男性50.9%），其中16,298例（3.7%）歸因於CRC。年齡標準化CRC死亡率自2004年的32.8降至2024年的23.1（每10萬人口），下降29.6%（P = .002）。在50至69歲個體中，CRC死亡率下降50.1%（自39.7降至19.8，每10萬人口）。分段迴歸分析發現在2012年出現顯著轉折點（95% CI，2011-2014；P < .001），即篩檢實施後3年。反事實分析估計，相較於未篩檢的預測趨勢，50至69歲族群CRC死亡率相對下降46.2%。在70歲以上個體中，CRC死亡率下降19.6%（自165.4降至132.9，每10萬人口），相較於預測值相對下降45.4%。整體而言，篩檢偵測出的4,892例CRC中，3,464例（70.8%）於整個研究期間被診斷為第I期或第II期。
結論與相關性：在此回溯性、以人群為基礎的描述性世代研究中，組織化FIT篩檢與CRC死亡率的持續下降相關，尤其在50至69歲個體中最為明顯。這些發現支持組織化FIT篩檢計畫作為降低CRC相關死亡率之公共衛生策略的長期效益。

papers.action: 目前不需改變手術做法；可留意篩檢政策使早期病人（70.8%為I-II期）比例上升，門診轉診時可據此加強大腸鏡篩檢衛教。

papers.title: JAK1-preferential inhibition in refractory inflammatory bowel disease: reframing upadacitinib as a strategy for rapid immune recalibration
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) management has moved from symptom control toward treat-to-target strategies, yet many patients with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease remain difficult to treat after primary non-response, secondary loss of response, or intolerance to advanced therapy. Upadacitinib, an oral Janus kinase 1 (JAK1)-preferential inhibitor, has shown clinically meaningful efficacy in both ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, including biologic-experienced populations. In this Perspective, we propose rapid immune recalibration as a hypothesis-generating clinical model for interpreting rapid inflammatory control following JAK1-preferential inhibition in selected patients with inflammation-dominant refractory IBD, rather than as an established biological mechanism or evidence of a durable immune reset. Recalibration is defined here as an early pharmacologically induced shift in the intensity and balance of convergent cytokine signaling, not as immune homeostasis restoration, mucosal healing, transmural repair, fibrosis reversal, or proven disease modification. We distinguish established clinical evidence from mechanistic rationale and from unvalidated downstream hypotheses, including barrier stabilization, microbiome change, anti-fibrotic potential, and biomarker-guided positioning. We also outline measurable clinical criteria, feasible biomarkers, exploratory translational endpoints, and safety boundaries that should guide future testing of this framework. This more bounded interpretation may help inform future efforts to move refractory IBD treatment from empirical drug switching toward mechanism-informed therapeutic choice without overstating the current evidence.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的治療已從症狀控制轉向治療至目標策略，但許多潰瘍性結腸炎或克隆氏症患者在原發性無反應、次發性反應喪失或對進階治療不耐受後仍屬難治。Upadacitinib是一種口服JAK1（Janus kinase 1）優先抑制劑，已在潰瘍性結腸炎與克隆氏症（包括曾使用生物製劑的族群）中展現具臨床意義的療效。在本篇觀點文章中，我們提出「快速免疫再校準」作為一個假說生成性的臨床模型，用以解釋特定發炎主導型難治性IBD患者在接受JAK1優先抑制劑後所觀察到的快速發炎控制現象，而非將其視為已確立的生物學機制或持久免疫重置的證據。此處所定義的「再校準」是指藥理誘導下、早期發生的細胞激素匯聚訊號強度與平衡的轉變，並非免疫homeostasis恢復、黏膜癒合、穿壁修復、纖維化逆轉或已證實的疾病修飾。我們區分了已確立的臨床證據、機制性推論，以及尚未驗證的下游假說（包括屏障穩定化、微生物群改變、抗纖維化潛力及生物標記導向定位）。我們也概述了未來測試此框架時應遵循的可衡量臨床標準、可行的生物標記、探索性轉譯終點與安全邊界。這種更有界限的詮釋方式，或有助於未來將難治性IBD治療從經驗性換藥推向機制導向的治療選擇，同時避免過度誇大現有證據。

papers.title: Checkpoint-insulated triple-signal artificial antigen-presenting cells drive antigen relay and systemic antitumor immunity
papers.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
papers.journal_full: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
papers.authors: Zhao S, Shi T, Tian T, Zhang F, Zhang Z, Xu H
papers.abstract: Dendritic cell (DC) vaccines offer professional antigen presentation but are often limited by suboptimal trafficking to lymphoid tissues, whereas whole tumor cell vaccines preserve antigenic diversity yet frequently lack coordinated activation cues for efficient T cell priming. Here, we report OncoAPC, an inactivated artificial antigen-presenting cell designed around a triple-signal priming logic: MHC-I-mediated antigen presentation (signal 1), CD80-mediated costimulation (signal 2) with checkpoint-insulating capacity, and incorporated IL-12 (signal 3). Mechanistically, OncoAPC directly activated T cells while partially insulating against PD-1 suppression through cis CD80:PD-L1 interactions and simultaneously engaged endogenous DCs to relay tumor antigens via cross-dressing and amplify lymphoid priming. Across multiple tumor models, OncoAPC showed broad therapeutic activity, including marked suppression of metastatic tumor burden and substantial control of established tumors, outperforming conventional DC vaccination. It further retained efficacy beyond the MC38 backbone and remained active when generated from human tumor cells or excised tumor-derived material. These findings establish OncoAPC as a scalable, broad-spectrum cancer vaccine platform that integrates antigenic diversity with DC-like functional precision.
papers.title_zh: 以檢查點絕緣三重訊號人工抗原呈現細胞驅動抗原傳遞與全身性抗腫瘤免疫
papers.abstract_zh: 樹突狀細胞（DC）疫苗提供專業的抗原呈現功能，但常受限於其在淋巴組織中運輸效率不佳；而全腫瘤細胞疫苗雖能保留抗原多樣性，卻經常缺乏協調性的活化訊號以有效引發T細胞致敏。本研究報告OncoAPC，一種以三重訊號致敏邏輯設計的去活化人工抗原呈現細胞：MHC-I介導的抗原呈現（訊號1）、CD80介導的共刺激（訊號2，具有檢查點絕緣能力）、以及內含的IL-12（訊號3）。機制上，OncoAPC能直接活化T細胞，同時透過cis CD80:PD-L1交互作用部分絕緣PD-1抑制，並同時招募內生性DC以透過交叉裝飾（cross-dressing）傳遞腫瘤抗原，放大淋巴組織中的致敏效應。在多個腫瘤模型中，OncoAPC展現廣泛的治療活性，包括顯著抑制轉移性腫瘤負荷，並對已建立的腫瘤有實質控制效果，優於傳統DC疫苗。此外，其效果不僅限於MC38背景模型，當以人類腫瘤細胞或切除的腫瘤組織製成時仍保持活性。這些發現確立OncoAPC為一種可擴充、廣效的癌症疫苗平台，整合了抗原多樣性與DC樣的功能精確性。

papers.title: Routes to colorectal cancer in Lynch syndrome: a decade of molecular and clinical insights converging on Schrödinger's cat
papers.authors: Ahadova A, Fayyaz F, Marin Grez L, Bläker H, Kloor M
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) development in Lynch syndrome (LS) has long been regarded to follow an adenoma-carcinoma sequence accelerated in comparison to microsatellite-stable (MSS) CRC development. Yet, several clinical observations challenged this hypothesis, most notably the persistently high CRC incidence under colonoscopy surveillance, a non-measurable benefit from shorter screening intervals, and substantial differences in cancer risk between carriers of the different mismatch repair (MMR) genes. Advances in the last decade have produced new hypotheses, highlighting the distinct biology of LS CRC and unravelling several co-existing pathways to cancer. Alongside the genomic heterogeneity, the immunogenic load created by the accumulation of frameshift mutations imposing selective pressure and leading to immune evasion, appears to be a critical step for cancer manifestation. We discuss potential clinical implications of these advances in understanding CRC pathogenesis for cancer prevention in LS and outline open questions that remain.
papers.title_zh: Lynch症候群大腸直腸癌的發生路徑：十年分子與臨床洞見匯聚於薛丁格的貓
papers.abstract_zh: 長期以來，Lynch症候群（LS）中大腸直腸癌（CRC）的發生被認為遵循一種較微衛星穩定型（MSS）CRC更為加速的腺瘤-癌序列。然而，多項臨床觀察對此假說提出挑戰，最顯著的是：在大腸鏡監測下CRC發生率仍持續偏高、縮短篩檢間隔並未顯示可測量的益處，以及不同錯配修復（MMR）基因帶因者之間癌症風險存在顯著差異。過去十年的進展提出了新的假說，凸顯LS CRC獨特的生物學特性，並揭示多條並存的致癌路徑。除了基因體異質性外，因框移突變累積所產生的免疫原性負荷（施加選擇壓力並導致免疫逃逸）似乎是癌症表現的關鍵步驟。本文討論這些對CRC致病機轉理解的進展，對LS癌症預防可能帶來的臨床意涵，並列出仍待解答的問題。
